items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...That's Mama Lou's church. ... Howard and Handy would play down there sometimes in the church. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, huh.

ctx.x: Well, this must be up on Flake Street, eh? I don't know. You know they got a homeless church up there. Blake, that's up in Colton, eh? Well, I tell you now.
No, no, that's way down in Gentile. That's Mama Lou's church. Oh. Howard and Handy would play down there sometimes in the church.
